scope: All 12 Project Rules Agent draft rules compared with the active G001-G007 pack. Processing rules only; no changes to scientific project requirements.
conclusion: Generic preservation, deduplication, provenance, version binding and actionable failures belong to shared governance. A module rule should add a concrete local responsibility, field contract, check or release decision instead of paraphrasing governance.

ownership_policy.canonical_text: Maintain each shared principle once in workflow_governance.json. Module records reference shared owners and add only local requirements.
ownership_policy.delivery: Materialize applicable full general instructions once per fresh request, then the required module details. A reference alone is not sufficient model context.
ownership_policy.scientific_profile: Reuse the approved 13-category detail profile and relevant versioned PK appendix. Preserve all details; do not import compression-only workflow instructions or copy the profile into every module.
ownership_policy.approval: Retain original approval records and replacement mappings. Do not automatically approve changed wording or renumber pending rules during this audit.

findings.shared_content: Evidence is not normative authority; preserve source status and version.
findings.module_delta: Re-read designated original project materials and determine which candidate obligations are adopted and currently effective.

findings.shared_content: Distinguish facts, assumptions, requirements and suggestions.
findings.module_delta: Reuse compression-owned facts and assumptions; extract obligations to use assumptions, account for non-rule source clauses, and return upstream correction requests.

findings.shared_content: Preserve meaning, numbers, conditions, negation, uncertainty and provenance.
findings.module_delta: Check obligation strength, actor or target and linked qualifications; apply the full shared scientific detail profile and PK binding appendix to requirement extraction.

findings.shared_content: Support claims with evidence; distinguish missingness states; preserve counterevidence.
findings.module_delta: Record separately whether original clauses support the complete obligation and whether authorized project evidence adopts it. One source may establish both.

findings.shared_content: True-duplicate merging, qualifier preservation, source mappings and review binding already have general owners.
findings.module_delta: Retain explicit source-unit-to-candidate-to-final-rule mapping in PRC011. Keep deterministic merge keys in the local implementation contract; do not make exact text equality a universal algorithm.

findings.shared_content: Preserve authority, versions and prior approvals. Explicit replacement scope and the rule that newer dates alone do not override are not fully stated in current G006.
findings.module_delta: Record predecessor project rule or source clause, replacement scope, activation condition and publication blockers.

findings.shared_content: Preserve relevant scope and pass only task-needed information.
findings.module_delta: Distinguish stage routing from applicability; specify the local UNASSIGNED state and typed conditions. Routing is not evidence of applicability or compliance.

findings.shared_content: Provide actionable findings and preserve unresolved information.
findings.module_delta: Define which requirement-authority, meaning or scope gaps block publication and which later-stage scientific gaps can be deferred. Generic issue fields can use a common schema.

findings.shared_content: Objective-first alignment, no unsupported changes and preservation of constraints.
findings.module_delta: Place pure-objective versus binding-requirement classification in PRC002. Place effective main.json versus final rules consistency in PRC011; send required context revisions upstream.

findings.shared_content: Preserve identity and time meaning; host-controlled identifiers.
findings.module_delta: Keep citation IDs distinct from downstream dataset IDs; define unallocated IDs, local missing-value encoding, observation_window, required_phase, trigger and deadline. Do not force one schema's sentinel values on all modules.

findings.shared_content: Reviews bind exact versions; retain failures and invalidate changed reviews.
findings.module_delta: Review the final organized rule package against admitted originals, require faithfulness/completeness/conflict outcomes and bidirectional coverage, then deterministically validate before release. Include PRC005 mappings and PRC009 context consistency.

findings.shared_content: Deliver complete applicable instructions, correct version binding and scoped acceptance.
findings.module_delta: Publish project_rules.json, reference it from main.json, retain rule_audit.json and define rule-use records. Downstream applicability/compliance execution remains deferred.

proposed_general_clarifications.text: Treat statements as duplicates only when their meaning and relevant scope, strength, conditions, exceptions and information status are equivalent. Identical wording alone does not establish equivalence; retain all supporting provenance.

An authorized revision must identify the prior requirement or specification, affected scope and effective conditions. A newer date alone does not establish replacement; retain predecessor and decision evidence.
Check that evidence supports a claim in its context, including relevant qualifications and counterevidence. A matching quotation, identifier or valid schema alone does not establish semantic support.

not_generalized: Mandatory three-way semantic review or three model calls for every workflow step.
Project Rules Agent source-to-candidate-to-final-rule coverage and publication schema.
Exact-text merge keys or NOT_SPECIFIED/UNASSIGNED values as universal algorithms or encodings.
Compression-only source access, extraction ownership or workflow restrictions.
Specific PK scientific profile contents as mandatory subject matter for unrelated modules.
runtime_observations: project_rule_agent.request() already returns governed_request(payload), which attaches the full general pack.
The runtime still supplies its older inline PRC001-PRC010; the 12-rule review draft is disabled and not loaded.
Therefore removing duplicate prose from the review draft alone would not remove runtime duplication; a later approved implementation must update the runtime module contract and verification.

verification_scope.review: Static ownership review, not a live-model accuracy evaluation.

follow_up.authorization: User requested the shared additions and a focused reorganization of PRC rules.
follow_up.general_clarifications: GC01-GC03 incorporated into G005, G006 and G004 respectively.
follow_up.historical_scope: The findings and verification_scope above describe the original pre-change audit; archived input paths retain that evidence.
